audience: site editors and developers who manage content on a Drupal website

useCases.title: List the latest articles or pages
useCases.text: The AI lists content of one type, sorted and paged, for example the newest articles, with fields you ask for.

useCases.title: Find pages by words in the title
useCases.text: The AI searches nodes of a content type whose title contains your text, for example holiday hours.

useCases.title: Discover the content types of a site
useCases.text: The AI lists the resource types of the site (entity types and bundles) so you know what content exists.

useCases.title: Draft a new article or page
useCases.text: The AI creates a new content item of a type you choose, with the title and fields you give.

useCases.title: Update or delete existing content
useCases.text: The AI finds a node, taxonomy term, user or file entry and updates the fields you name, or deletes it when you ask.

useCases.title: Review taxonomy terms, users or files
useCases.text: The AI lists taxonomy terms, users or files with sorting and one filter, and summarizes them.
